scope: Stored uncapped and Q3-capped four MLP structures plus existing matched-head external models; full Validation/Test; descriptive only

best_definitions.primary: Within each task/dataset choose the same arm with minimum mean fullValidation RMSE over seeds42/52/62; retain its paired MAE and Test results. Ties mean MAE then model name. Descriptive selection, not prospective confirmation.
best_definitions.secondary: For each split and each metric separately, show minimum 3seed mean among the fixed four MLP arms or fixed external6; identify model. Test minima are retrospective and not a newly selected validated model.

comparability.cap_vs_uncapped: different observed inputs and targets; no difference/percentage gain or superiority computed
comparability.uncapped_mlp_vs_external: only population-compatible, same split and 3seed stored results; retain matched-head/runtime/provenance limits
comparability.cap_external: missing unless stored capped external results identified; never substitute raw external scores

seed_aggregation: mean and sample SD ddof1; include all3seeds including worse results
metrics: overall raw quantity RMSE and MAE, time_nll auxiliary when directly available; no pooled raw errors across datasets
